detail.stepsHeading: How it works, step by step

items.title: Customer Service Bot
items.description: Automated replies and support, available around the clock.
items.useCase: Built for businesses that get a lot of repeat questions (hours, prices, availability) and can't keep up answering each one by hand. It plugs into WhatsApp or the site chat and replies instantly, escalating to a human only when judgment is needed.
steps: Escalates to a human when needed
items.demoPlaceholder: e.g. Do you offer home delivery?
items.demoOutputTemplate: 🤖 AI replies: got your message "{input}" — confirming the info or connecting you with an agent.

items.title: Sales Processor
items.description: From order to confirmed sale, no manual steps.
items.useCase: For anyone selling through a catalog or social media who processes orders by hand (writing them down, checking stock, building the order). The bot takes the order, validates it against inventory, and leaves it ready to invoice — no spreadsheets, no copy-pasting.
items.demoPlaceholder: e.g. I want 2 units of product X
items.demoOutputTemplate: ✅ Order registered: "{input}" — order generated and notification sent.

items.title: Social Media Publisher
items.description: Content prepared and published without friction.
items.useCase: For brands that post often but lose time building and uploading every post by hand. Content gets prepared, AI adjusts the format per network, and it publishes itself according to the defined schedule.
items.demoOutputTemplate: 📅 Post scheduled: "{input}" — ready to go out per the calendar.
